$comment: Birthright (ADR 0012 tier T3): HR attributes decide who holds core access, through ONE Entra ID Governance automatic assignment policy per access package.
Applied by lab/scripts/powershell/post-apply/Set-AutoAssignmentPolicies.ps1 (dry run first: -RenderOnly needs no tenant). Nothing here has run against a tenant.
Every (department, jobTitle) pair in lab/scripts/mock-hr/hr_feed.csv has a jobProfile below - tests/Set-AutoAssignmentPolicies.Tests.ps1 fails if a persona is added to the feed without one.

Rules: requestable extras stay request-based (approval + expiry) and live in their OWN package (e.g. 'ICU - Float Access'), never as a second policy on a birthright package; privileged access is NEVER birthright (PIM eligibility only); rules never use memberOf (quarantined from 2026-11-03, Microsoft Learn).

settings.matchOnNote: jobTitle today, because that is what hr_feed.csv carries. Target state is jobCode (titles are free text, ADR 0012): switch matchOn to jobCode once HR sends a job code and it lands in the attribute below.
settings.attributesNote: verify: extensionAttribute1 is a placeholder for the HR job code. It must be written by HR provisioning only - Microsoft Learn warns that dynamic-rule security depends on who can write the attribute (on-premises SELF write included).
settings.baseConditionsNote: A disabled leaver falls out of scope at once, so 04-Leaver's package removal is not re-added by the policy. Guests are never in scope (they use the B2B catalog). The hire-date gate keeps PHI access from an enabled pre-hire before day one (HIPAA minimum necessary): hr_feed.csv 'joiner' rows are SCIM active=true before their startDate. Microsoft Learn (dynamic membership rules, checked 2026-10-20) documents employeeHireDate (preview) with -le / -ge and system.now. verify: an automatic-assignment policy rule accepts it (same rule syntax per Learn, not confirmed for this property); verify: a user with NO employeeHireDate does not match (fail closed). HR startDate is sent as the SCIM extension hireDate by lab/scripts/mock-hr/Invoke-InboundProvisioning.ps1; the provisioning and Cloud Sync mappings to employeeHireDate are tenant-time steps, and Set-AutoAssignmentPolicies.ps1 refuses to create the policies while no in-scope user carries a hire date.
settings.gracePeriodNote: 72 hours (ADR 0012): a mover is not cut off mid-shift. P3D = 72 h; the portal accepts hours or days.
settings.policyDescription: Automatic assignment from HR attributes (ADR 0012 T3). Managed by lab/iga/birthright-rules.json via Set-AutoAssignmentPolicies.ps1 - change the rule file, not the portal.

neverBirthright.rationale: Privileged access is granted only as PIM eligibility and certified quarterly (T1). A birthright package that reached a privileged group would be standing privilege handed out by an HR attribute.

jobProfiles.note: ICU float shifts are requested through the separate T2 package 'ICU - Float Access' (180-day expiry, manager approval). The ICU birthright package itself has no request path.

Nurse managers cover clinical shifts, so they keep the clinical bundle and can request ICU float access like any nurse. Their PIM eligibility (Set-PimGroupEligibility.ps1) stays separate and reviewed quarterly.

Mover target (Marcus Bello, Nursing -> ICU): the department change moves him from the Nurse policy to the ICU policy; the 72 h grace keeps the old bundle through his first ICU shifts. A float nurse hired into ICU keeps any 'ICU - Float Access' assignment until it expires or is denied - that removal never touches this birthright package.
Payment posting and adjustments are NOT requestable for this profile: SOD-09 (charge entry vs payment posting).
Adjustment and write-off authority is discretionary, so a person approves it and re-certifies it every 180 days (T2). No charge-entry birthright, so no SOD-09 conflict.
Executives do not chart; anything clinical is requested by exception. All-Workforce (dynamic group) is the only baseline.

Workforce account only: no privileged birthright (neverBirthright). Admin work is done from a separate cloud-only adm- account in lab/iga/admin-accounts.json that is only ever PIM-eligible (Set-PimGroupEligibility.ps1).
